mechanic_2: Shelter: Activate to shelter your Green anole or Northern cardinal. Block its next loss of 1 Population before your next turn.
extra_info: One Shelter per animal. Crape myrtle aphid feeds on this tree. Maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Grow: In Plant Growth, spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat up to maximum 3.
mechanic_2: Pollinator Invitation: Activate; spend 1 Light to add Bloom. Next Hoverfly visit gives it an extra +1 Population. Remove Bloom.
extra_info: One Bloom per plant; expires at your next turn. Maximum 3 Population.

mechanic_1: Caterpillar Munch: Feed on Frogfruit anywhere. Crescent +1 Population; Frogfruit -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Butterfly Visit: Pollinate Frogfruit, Firewheel, or Sunflower anywhere. Both gain +1 Population.
extra_info: One card represents both life stages. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Crack Seeds: Feed on Sunflower, Inland sea oats, or Sideoats grama anywhere. Cardinal +1 Population; plant -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Catch Insects: Hunt Grasshopper, Phaon crescent, or Hoverfly anywhere. Cardinal +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
extra_info: Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3. Choose one action when activated.

mechanic_1: Flower Visit: Pollinate Frogfruit, Firewheel, Sunflower, Pink evening primrose, or Mealy blue sage anywhere. Both +1 Population.
mechanic_2: Hungry Larva: Hunt Crape myrtle aphid anywhere. Hoverfly +1 Population; aphid -1 Population.
extra_info: Adults visit flowers; larvae eat aphids. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Shred Leaf Litter: Turn one face-up plant in Compost face down; move it to the bottom. Give one of your plants +1 Population.
mechanic_2: Hide in Mulch: After Shred Leaf Litter, shelter this Pillbug. Block its next loss of 1 Population before your next turn.
extra_info: Always playable. Shredding gives Pillbug no Population. Enter with 1; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Munch Leaves: Feed on Inland sea oats, Sideoats grama, Sunflower, or Pink evening primrose anywhere. Hopper +1; plant -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Jump Away: When hunted, if at 2+ Population, spend 1 Population to cancel the hunt. Hunter gains nothing. Once per round.
extra_info: Jump Away is a reaction, not an activation. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Snap Up Insects: Hunt Grasshopper, Hoverfly, or Phaon crescent anywhere. Anole +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Territorial Display: Choose an opponent's Green anole. It cannot hunt until your next turn. Each target: once per round.
extra_info: Use a Territory marker. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Sip Sap: Feed on Crape myrtle anywhere. Aphid +1 Population; tree -1 Population.
extra_info: Prey for Hoverfly larvae. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.
